question: R&D A: does tool granularity change agent behaviour?
method: Up to max_turns model turns per task; tool results simulated with fixed payloads; predicted calls mapped to canonical server tools. tool_selection_accuracy = predicted tool set equals expected set; argument_accuracy = expected (key,value) pairs matched after normalisation, over all expected keys; tokens = provider-reported input+output tokens summed over turns.
